posts.headline: Shake N Bakers finally lost one, and suddenly triciagloston's 'quiet dominance' saga hits its first real plot twist at 5-1.
posts.detail: Still league-best 879.84 points-for and still the gold standard, but after twenty-two straight editions of unbeaten talk, the Bakers now have to prove that loss was a blip and not the start of a fade with a 5.5 career average finish lurking underneath.

posts.headline: Thicks drops to 4-2 and the ring is officially looking more like a relic than a resume heading into the stretch run.
posts.detail: Thirty-one editions deep and that 14-14 career record with a 5.5 average finish is finally matching the vibes — a champion clinging to 721.1 points-for, lowest among all the 4-2 teams in the league.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner is 1-5 now, and this isn't a slump anymore — it's a full-blown collapse of a supposed juggernaut.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and league-best 1.5 average finish built an entire reputation, and 31 straight editions later Put it in Ra is cratering toward the division basement with zero signs of life.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh falls to 1-5 and the name has fully completed its transformation from joke to destiny.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and dead-last 12 average finish said this was coming, and 613.1 points-for confirms the untalented tenth is exactly who we said he was.

posts.headline: The African Bald Fraud is quietly building the best case against his own nickname at 5-1 with 819.24 points.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops carries a modest 15-13 career record and 4 average finish, but right now he's one game back of the league lead — the fraud talk has to go on pause until this streak actually breaks.
